script:
o=$(mktemp); kind(){ line=; read -r line < "$o"; case $line in "["*) echo full;; "") echo none;; *) echo pid;; esac; }; f(){ return 1; }; f & p=$!; while kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 0.01; done; wait $p; echo a=$?; wait %1; echo b=$?
wait %1 2>/dev/null; echo c=$?; wait $p; echo d=$?; rm -f "$o"

bash52.output:
a=1
bash: line 1: wait: %1: no such job
b=127
c=127
d=1
